deployment: NVIDIA-hosted private preview on one H100 (Brev), BF16; the engine runs two requests at a time
prompt: Transcribe this audio. Include all spoken words.
input_audio: the frozen clip WAV exactly as streamed to providers (retained speech plus 1 s appended silence), base64 in the request
pricing_note: Private preview endpoint; NVIDIA has published no per-minute price.
measurement_caveat: Each clip is uploaded whole and transcribed after it ends, so only transcript accuracy is comparable with the streaming providers; no streaming, deadline or completion latency is measured.
